dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Rest for a while? Well, if you insist!

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Managing one's stamina is a crucial skill for any adventurer.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Do you want Lumi to give you a back rub? It'll be gentle! At least... I think it will!

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: A new challenge... I can't wait!

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: I've seen some stuff while adventuring in the wild, but I never thought a storybook adventure could be this interesting.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: I've never been more prepared! Don't forget to give me a shout when you're ready to head out!

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Have you had a chat with Wolfy? We talked for a while, and he told me a lot of interesting things.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Plus, he's so furry! Not like Lumi...

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Oh, no, no, no! I shouldn't compare. They're both wonderful in their own ways!
